name: project-in-title
description: Tags each session title with a coloured project marker, e.g. "🟣 my-app · Fix login bug", so a date-sorted session list still shows which project each chat belongs to.

colors.title: Project colours
colors.description: Comma-separated project=colour pairs, e.g. "my-app=purple, docs=green". Colours: purple, blue, green, yellow, orange, red, brown, black, white. Projects not listed get a colour picked from their name.
